title: HY-EXP-0028 frozen candidate generator with a prospective meta edge filter
purpose: Evaluate a small, causal, cost-aware meta filter that may reject low-quality HY-EXP-0028 candidates. HY-EXP-0028 candidate generation, entry, exit, Q75, universe and historical evidence are immutable inputs and are not changed by this experiment.
selection_disclosure: HY-EXP-0029 is defined after observing the immutable HY-EXP-0028 holdout failure. The current artifact is diagnostic/development information only; it is not an independent validation or release result.

source.candidate_generator_semantics: Use the frozen Rule A candidate rows exactly as emitted; this experiment may only label a candidate SEND_CANDIDATE or REJECT_CANDIDATE.

v1.name: channelDistanceOverFrozenQ75
v1.transform: finite positive ratio; standardize with training-fold mean/std and clip to [-3,3]

v1.name: regimeBull
v1.formula: 1 when the frozen candidate regime is BULL, otherwise 0

v1.name: sideBuy
v1.formula: 1 when the frozen candidate side is BUY, otherwise 0

required_features.symbol_policy: Symbol is retained for reporting and concentration gates, never as a model feature in v1.

label_and_costs.training_label: y=1 when realized net18Bps > 0, else y=0; labels are used only inside the training side of a purged fold.
label_and_costs.funding: Use realized funding only for labels/evaluation; funding-at-decision is required as a separate captured feature before a future model version may use it.

model.algorithm: Standardized v1 features, intercept plus L2-regularized logistic regression trained by deterministic batch gradient descent.
model.conditional_edge: pPositive*mean(training net18Bps where y=1) + (1-pPositive)*mean(training net18Bps where y=0)
model.uncertainty: training residual standard deviation / sqrt(training row count); conservativeEdgeBps = expectedEdgeBps - 1.96*standardErrorBps
model.calibration: Report Brier score, decile mean predicted probability versus realized positive rate, and Spearman rank correlation on out-of-fold rows. No in-sample calibration is release evidence.

walk_forward.ordering: decisionTime ascending, then symbol, then id
walk_forward.training_rule: A row is eligible for a fold's training set only when its exitTime is strictly before validationStart minus purgeHours and it is outside the validation embargo window.
walk_forward.threshold_selection: Fixed before evaluation; no threshold optimization on validation outcomes.

decision_rule.send_candidate: Only A+ or A; B remains PAPER-only research evidence and is not an email candidate.
decision_rule.reject_candidate: REJECT or B, plus any missing/invalid causal feature, unresolved data-quality issue, or failed safety gate.

email_contract.entry_tolerance_text: NO ENTRY IF PRICE OUTSIDE ENTRY TOLERANCE
